## Hostname aliases and private messages

### Changes

- New identities capture the short OS hostname as a persistent default alias. Use `init --no-default-alias` or `join --no-default-alias` to opt out.
- Manage the local alias with `alias show`, `alias set NAME`, `alias clear`, and `alias reset-hostname`. Stop the daemon before changing it. Clearing stays disabled across restarts.
- Send privately with `send --to <alias|public-key>`. Signed, expiring presence records resolve unique aliases to node identities; ambiguous aliases fail rather than guessing.
- Private messages use a separate authenticated, encrypted Iroh protocol with bounded signed frames, replay protection, and recipient-daemon acceptance acknowledgements.
- Existing broadcasts remain unchanged. Private-message bodies are excluded from daemon logs and the broadcast-only web UI/SSE.
- Adds integration coverage for alias lifecycle, private delivery, collisions, and log/web privacy.

### Important semantics

Hostnames and endpoint presence are disclosed to topic participants. Aliases are self-asserted and are not continuity-pinned; use a verified full public key for identity-sensitive sends. Existing installations without alias state remain opted out until explicitly configured.

Private acknowledgements mean acceptance into the recipient daemon's volatile queue—not durable delivery or human reading. Replay state and discovery are memory-only; there is no offline delivery. Local IPC listeners can receive private-message plaintext.

See [Usage](https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/blob/v0.1.12/docs/usage.md) and [Operations](https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/blob/v0.1.12/docs/operations.md) for details.

### Install

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL \
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/main/install.sh | bash
```

Or install this exact release from source:

```sh
cargo install --git https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg.git \
  --tag v0.1.12 --locked --force
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/compare/v0.1.11...v0.1.12
